name: lore-plugin
description: Marketplace for the lore plugin — a per-repo, PR-reviewed knowledge base engine for AI coding agents

plugins.name: lore
plugins.description: Knowledge engine for AI coding agents: auto-evaluates each substantial session for 'facts you cannot derive from the code', persists them to the repo's docs/ai-knowledge/, generates an index plus path-scoped retrieval rules, and reviews all knowledge through normal code PRs.
